newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: PTT, Petronas discover gas at joint area.
newsitem.headline: PTT, Petronas discover gas at joint area.

text.p: Thailand's PTT Exploration & Production PCL and Malaysia's national oil firm Petronas, have discovered gas at the Malaysia-Thai development area, the joint authority said in a statement on Monday.

"The Malaysia-Thailand Joint Authority announced today that its contractors in Block-17 have successfully completed drilling and testing the Amarit-1 wildcat well on the Amarit Prospect, a new discovery gas field, in the Joint Development Area," the statement said.

Well Amarit-1, which was spudded on March 30 was drilled to a depth of 3,150 metres to test hydrocarbon potentials of the Prospect in the Block. "The well encountered several gas-bearing sands," the statement said.
Three drill stem tests were conducted over the depth intervals' range of 2,009 to 2,764 metres.
The tests yielded a stable gas flow rate of eight million standard cubic feet per day plus 326 barrels per day of condensate of 45 degree API gravity, measured through a choke size of 64/64 inches.
The block has two contractors -- PTTEP International Ltd and Petronas Carigali (JDA) Sdn Bhd.
The operator of the block, Carigali-PTTEPI Operating Company Sdn Bhd, has already plugged and abandoned the well, the statement said.

The Malaysia-Thailand Joint Authority is a statutory body vested with the exclusive rights, powers, liberties and privileges of exploring petroleum resources in the joint development area offshore Malaysia and Thailand.
